verdict.rationale: Langfuse does not publish any explicit statement about not using customer data to train AI models, but its self-hosting option (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform for AWS/Azure/GCP) means an org can keep all trace/prompt data entirely within its own infrastructure, which indirectly prevents that data from reaching Langfuse's own systems or being used for model training. Missing for 10: explicit data-usage/training policy, DPA or privacy documentation addressing model training, and independent confirmation of this stance for Langfuse Cloud users.
